tei:div.tei:p: (391)bh+yoḥ chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i zhing*/ gzhi gnas ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga/ 'bum phrag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes/ rnal 'byor rtsa rlung nyams pa dang*/ phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa las/ mkha' 'gro'i sun ma 'byung ba na/ ye shes mkha' 'gro mi g.yo yang*/ 'jig rten tshul 'jin mkha' 'gro rnams/ 'dod yon longs spyod dgyes par rol/ rdo rje'i glu dang gar gyis mchod/ lta sgom spyod pas nyams bshags na/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i dar sna bsdus/ gsang sngags rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ 'di na bzhugs pa'i mched lcam kun/ tshe 'phrang bar chad khyod kyis sol/ rdo rje tshe yi dpal khug cig bh+yoḥ mkha' (392)dbyings bde chen zhing khams na/ stong gsal 'bras bu'i mkha' 'gro lnga/ ye shes ḍāk+ki bye ba 'bum/ 'khor dang yang 'khor bsam mi khyab/ 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes/ rnal 'byor rtsa rlung nyams pa dang*/ phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa las/ mkha' 'gro'i sun ma 'byung ba na/ ye shes mkha' 'gro mi g.yo yang*/ 'jig rten tshul 'jin mkha' 'gro rnams/ 'dod yon longs spyod dgyes par ro/ rdo rje'i glu dang gar gyis mchod/ lta sgom spyod pa nyams bshags na/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i dar sna bsdus/ gsang sngags rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ 'di na bzhugs pa'i mched lcam kun/ tshe 'phrang bar chad khyod kyis sol/ rdo rje tshe yi dpal khug cig bh+yoḥ gnas (393)mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi na/ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo'i nyi shu bzhi/ gtso mo mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs/ 'khor gyis mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum/ sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges ste/ la la rgan la la la gzhon/ la la chags bzhad la la khro/ tshul dang tshul min ma nges ste/ lam la slob pa'i tshul ston cing*/ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams/ 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs mchod bzhes/

rnal 'byor rtsa rlung nyams pa dang*/ phyi nang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa las/ mkha' 'gro'i sun ma 'byung ba na/ ye shes mkha' 'gro mi g.yo kyang*/ 'jig rten tshul 'jin mkha' 'gro rnams/ 'dod yon longs spyod dgyes par rol/ rdo rje glu dang gar gyis mchod/ lta sgom spyod pas nyams bshags na/ (394)dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i dar sna bsdus/ gsang sngags rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ 'di na bzhugs pa'i mched lcam kun/ tshe 'phrang bar chad khyod kyis sol/ rdo rje tshe yi dpal khug cig mdor na gnas gsum bzhugs pa yi/ ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rnams/ 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi longs spyod bzhes/ thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis pa/ mthol lo bshags so nyams pa bskang*/ dbyings dang 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rnams/ mi g.yo rang gnas dbyings la bzhugs/ sun mi bar chad ma btang zhig dam tshig gnyan la dgongs mjod la/ rdo rje slob dpon gdan la 'dren/ 'gro rnams ldong bar 'god du mchi/ rdo rje mched lcam gdan la 'dren/ lam gyi (395)(396)bar chad 'gyur bas na/ dar thag bsdus la tshe 'phrang sol/ skye mchi med pa bde chen klong*/ zhabs pad brten pa'i bkra shis stsol/
rdo rje mched kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ bka' yin gter min smyon pa'i tshig dag snang min ma snyan brgyud 'ang min/ shugs 'byung smyon pa'i glu ngag 'di/ gzhon nu chu skyes ming gis sbyar/ dge'o//
